parameters.content:
## Reconciliation -- hourly safety net
Does NOT drive normal ticket creation. Its only job: find mail still sitting in the raw Inbox more than 10 minutes after arrival (meaning the webhook either missed it, or something failed mid-processing) and feed it through the exact same Core Processor pipeline.

No separate overlap-lock is needed on THIS workflow -- Core Processor's own per-item lock already makes it safe for this to run concurrently with Main, or with itself if a previous hourly run somehow overruns. Worst case on overlap: the second call to Core Processor for the same email finds the ticket already created and safely no-ops into the 'duplicate_thread' branch.

### Monitoring tip
If this workflow regularly finds mail older than ~1 hour still in Inbox, that's a signal the Outlook Trigger's webhook subscription may have silently stopped renewing -- worth investigating rather than just letting Reconciliation quietly cover for it indefinitely.
